symbols.read: Price has dropped to 740.17 from 749.04, a decisive slide that has pushed the 1H trend down and filled the 742.24–743.00 bull FVG, leaving only the 739.63–739.88 demand zone beneath price — the bullish bias now rests on that final cushion. The overhead picture has worsened: two bear FVGs at 742.64–744.39 and 745.09–746.32 now stack directly above, replacing the single 748.48–749.19 gap, so any bounce faces layered supply before the 758.44 pivot. The combined signal stays HOLD with the 4H still bullish, but momentum has clearly deteriorated from the prior read's fading consolidation into an active 1H downtrend. Invalidation remains a sustained break below 737.02, which reopens 722.40 and then 686.36 and would finally arm the currently dead SELL at 722.40; holding 739.63–739.88 keeps the bullish structure intact.

The BUY setup is now invalidated: price broke below the 83,713.91 entry and the 82,924.47–83,100.15 bull FVG base, sliding to 82,850.27, so the prior "bullish toward 86,743.46" call is revised to neutral-to-bearish near-term even though the 4H direction and BULLISH regime label still read bullish. The key change is the stack of three overhead bear FVGs (83,015–83,404, 83,484–84,083, 84,500–84,653) now sitting directly above price, capping any bounce, while the 1H trend has flipped down and the last 1H bar is flat (+0.01%). Bias is now defensive: rallies into 83,015–83,404 are the first supply test, and the 80,684.36 lower pivot is the regime line. Invalidation of the bearish lean is a reclaim of the 83,713.91 pivot and the 83,484–84,083 gap; a close below 82,413.00 confirms continuation toward 80,684.36.

The bearish view is confirmed and has strengthened: the 4H direction has flipped from bullish to bearish, so the prior neutral-to-bearish near-term bias is now outright bearish. Price at 2,444.75 sits below three stacked bear FVGs (2,445.84–2,448.12, 2,453.97–2,472.90, 2,482.49–2,484.34), with the lowest now acting as immediate overhead supply capping the weak +0.11% 1H bounce. The BUY setup is dead — entry 2,478.00, stop 2,481.87, and target 2,627.00 are all far above price, leaving the 2,329.00 lower pivot as the next downside magnet. Invalidation of the bearish bias requires a reclaim of 2,478.00 and a close through the 2,486.28–2,491.08 FVG; until then, rallies into 2,445–2,472 are sellable.

The bearish lean from the prior read has been confirmed and extended: price has fallen further to 105.48, the 1H trend has flipped from up to down, and the 4H direction now reads bearish, shifting the combined bias to SELL. Three stacked bear FVGs (107.55–107.90, 106.29–106.97, 105.81–105.92) now form layered overhead resistance, with the most recent gap sitting just above current price and capping any bounce. The 100.43 lower pivot remains the downside magnet, and the invalidated BUY setup (entry 108.25, stop 108.10) is now moot. Bias stays bearish; invalidation is a reclaim and hold above 108.25, which would neutralize the stacked gaps and revive the 116.07 target.

Price has extended the bearish leg to 56.36 from 57.48, and the 1H trend remains down (56.79→56.36, -0.77%), confirming rather than revising the prior bearish bias — the overhead 57.72–57.81 bear FVG was never reclaimed and a fresh stack of bear FVGs now sits between 56.79 and 57.81 as layered supply. Combined stays SELL with 4H bearish, and the short entry/stop cluster (58.41/58.58) remains untriggered and further away, so the original entry is stale; target stays 55.37. Invalidation is unchanged: a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward 61.45.

The bearish bias remains confirmed and the setup is now flagged INVALIDATED only because price has already traded well below the original 4,141.44 entry — the thesis itself played out, with price at 4,092.30 down from 4,125.50 and the 1H leg extending sharply (-0.58%). The 4,141.44 level has flipped from entry to upper pivot, meaning the prior risk band (entry 4,141.44 / stop 4,148.48) is now overhead resistance rather than a live trigger, and the two open bearish FVGs at 4,126.37–4,130.31 and 4,131.15–4,132.33 sit stacked above as supply. The 4,065.48 target is still ~27 points below, so continuation toward it is the path of least resistance while price holds under the 4,126–4,132 FVG cluster. A sustained close back above 4,141.44 (the flipped pivot) would neutralize the bearish structure; the original 4,148.48 invalidation remains the hard stop for any residual short.

Bias has weakened further from holding to testing the line: price slid from 1.37 to 1.35, sitting exactly on the upper pivot, and the 4H BUY signal has expired while the combined 4H+1H stays HOLD. A fresh bear FVG at 1.3532–1.3633 now sits directly overhead, joining the existing 1.3722–1.381 and 1.3837–1.3839 gaps, so the entire 1.35–1.384 zone is stacked supply rather than support. The 1H trend is still nominally up but the last candle was flat at -0.07%, showing no momentum to clear that wall. The 1.35 pivot is now the exact line in the sand — a sustained break below it, especially below 1.31, confirms the bullish retest has failed and opens the 1.26 lower pivot; reclaiming 1.3633 would be the first sign of repair toward the 1.44 target.
